## Pages

- [About and contact](https://sagarv.xyz/index.md): The current homepage as Markdown.
- [HTML homepage](https://sagarv.xyz/): The same content for web browsers.

The homepage supports Accept: text/markdown or the explicit /index.md URL.
HTML is the default representation. Markdown contains the complete homepage text,
including the quote and contact links, with no JavaScript required.
This site exposes no API or MCP tools. Use the published content as the source;
do not infer additional employment history or proprietary employer information.
